reviewer: Codex AI semantic review; not independent human approval
scope: Prepared 2,487 recommended title/abstract records and 13 saved replies. Does not cover full original threads or later replies.
licensing_note: No verified repository or post-author redistribution grant. Content approval applies only to the local classroom selection.
selection_policy: Default deny; only exact ID and text-hash matches on this allowlist may enter a local teaching pack.

Exclude political sensitivities, political/religious/group disputes, sexual innuendo or exploitation, gender stereotypes or antagonism, insults, disability/age humiliation, child harm, violence and unsafe acts.
Unclear context, missing images/full text and unselected examples remain out; an exclusion is not a judgment that every omitted record is harmful.
Keyword screening is a first exclusion step, never automatic approval; all remaining candidates were read semantically.
Do not append unreviewed comments when following source links. Forum jokes are not factual answers.
